title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m worried that Mikaela is in one of those depressed emo phases
You said she broke up with Shane, etc., was sounding needy for attention in those texts. After “call me later” I texted her “Hello” and nothing
Yeah, she probably is. Feels like it happens a couple times a month. Or once a week even
Reports of a breakthrough emanating from Fenech HQ
“I’m nearly positive we caught the Tigers lying.”
Emphasized ““I’m nearly positive we caught the Tigers lying.””
There’s a bottom to the e-mail, no start date. And the source believes he had been working there for a week
What day of the week did they send the e-mail? If it’s early in the week then it’s possible that’s when he started.
